review_kind: Independent visual review of six saved CI browser screenshots
scope: Appearance and readability in saved screenshot states only; automated proof is recorded separately.

capture_method.browser: Playwright Chromium, headless; Chrome channel unless ATLAS_CHROME_EXECUTABLE overrides executable.
capture_method.page: Locally served atlas-explorer.html in CI at http://127.0.0.1:18771.

phone.gesture_method: CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent with two touch points

capture_method.extreme_pan: Test sets 6x zoom and 45 degrees clockwise, then presses ArrowLeft and ArrowUp 75 times each.

observed: Selected orange cell is coherent with the surrounding rendered grid and central crosshair.
Readout visibly says I9, 50% east, 50% south.
Neighbouring cell labels and compass are legible; desktop selected cell subdivisions are visible.
Native central city imagery is visible beneath the overlay.
limits: Selected cell label is partly overlapped by the centre crosshair; the separate readout remains clear.
The underlying map is raster imagery and becomes visibly blurred at this zoom.
The screenshots alone do not resolve all faint source crosses sufficiently for independent subpixel calibration.

visual_observations.state: Clipped R18 edge, phone and desktop
observed: Orange selected region and probe are visibly within the map viewport at the clipped bottom-right edge.
Readout visibly says R18, 21% east, 18% south.
Partial rightmost column and bottom row are visibly narrower than complete cells.
Lower extension grid lines appear dashed; the map ends below and to the right of the selected partial region.
limits: The crosshair overlaps part of the selected R18 label; separate readout is readable.
The Edge extension confidence text is outside these captured viewport portions, so its readability is not visually verified here.

visual_observations.state: 45-degree extreme diagonal pan, phone and desktop
observed: A diagonal strip of map and overlay remains visible at the lower right; the viewport is not entirely empty.
Most of the viewport is background at this deliberately extreme pan.
Compass is rotated and the position readout visibly says 45 degrees clockwise.
The coordinate readout says to move the centre cross onto the grid.
limits: The capture demonstrates remaining intersection, not a comfortably centred city view.
The screenshots do not independently prove recovery gestures or continuous camera behaviour.

observed: Phone reference text wraps within its panel without visible horizontal overflow.
Desktop side panel controls and reference readout remain contained and readable.
Compass and bottom drag/zoom instruction remain visible.
Partial neighbouring grid labels at map-viewport boundaries are clipped with the map content.
limits: These are scrolled viewport captures; content above and below is not reviewed.
No baseline screenshot comparison was available for unchanged appearance assertions.

automated_results_separate_from_visual_r.source: proof.json produced by test harness; these claims were not established by static visual inspection.
reviewed_harness_assertions: Grid polygon follows actual rendered map to less than 1 CSS pixel in checked states, including rotation.
No horizontal page overflow after the interaction sequences.
Clipped edge target and selected-edge-point probe are visible.
Original IDs, immutable pin attributes and fixture storage values are preserved.
Grid availability failure fixtures leave original map operational.

nonblocking_observations: Centre crosshair overlaps selected cell text; separate reference readout supplies the same coordinate.
Extreme camera clamp retains a small map strip while allowing most of the viewport to show background.
approval_scope: Visual gate only. This report does not independently approve deployment, calibrate physical distances, validate real-device touch behaviour, or establish Supabase behaviour.
